paper.title_en: Light Primordial Black Holes from a First-Order Phase Transition near the End of Inflation: Baryogenesis and Gravitational Wave Signatures
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the formation and cosmological consequences of light primordial black holes (PBHs) from vacuum bubbles nucleated during a spectator sector first-order phase transition in inflation. We construct a phenomenological model in which the spectator potential evolves with the rolling inflaton, allowing vacuum bubbles to nucleate and grow during inflation. The vacuum ordering subsequently reverses near the end of inflation, leaving the bubble interiors in a metastable false vacuum state. We examine their stability against reverse vacuum tunneling and impose benchmark conditions to suppress this process before and after reheating. Sufficiently large bubbles can subsequently undergo supercritical evolution and form PBHs. In this framework, the PBH abundance is determined by the vacuum tunneling history, while the characteristic mass depends on the nucleation epoch and bubble growth during inflation. For sufficiently light PBHs that evaporate before big bang nucleosynthesis, Hawking radiation can create locally superheated regions in which electroweak symmetry is restored, potentially generating a baryon asymmetry in the presence of additional CP-violating interactions. We also investigate the direct gravitational wave (GW) signals from Hawking radiation and the induced GWs from PBH density fluctuations, the latter arising if an early PBH dominated epoch occurs. For representative benchmark parameters, the resulting baryon asymmetry can reach the ten-percent level of the observed value, while the induced GW signal can reach a peak amplitude of $Ω_{\rm GW,0}h^2\sim10^{-7}$ at frequencies of order $10$-$10^2\,{\rm Hz}$.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 本文结合旁观者扇区一阶相变、真空泡核化、原初黑洞形成、霍金辐射诱导电弱对称性恢复下的重子生成以及引力波信号，理论层次较深，机制链条完整，且给出基准参数下的可观测量估计。虽无引用与期刊信息，但发表仅3天，零引用属中性，值得点入进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 暴胀末期附近一阶相变产生的轻原初黑洞：重子生成与引力波特征
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在暴胀期间由旁观者扇区一阶相变核化的真空泡所形成的轻原初黑洞（PBH）的形成及其宇宙学后果。我们构建了一个唯象模型，其中旁观者势随滚动的暴胀子演化，使得真空泡能够在暴胀期间核化并增长。随后，真空有序在暴胀末期附近发生反转，使泡内部处于亚稳态的假真空态。我们考察了它们对反向真空隧穿的稳定性，并施加基准条件以在再加热之前和之后抑制该过程。足够大的泡随后可以经历超临界演化并形成PBH。在这一框架下，PBH丰度由真空隧穿历史决定，而特征质量取决于核化时期和暴胀期间的泡增长。对于足够轻、能在太初核合成之前蒸发的PBH，霍金辐射可以产生局部过热区域，在其中电弱对称性得以恢复，并在存在额外CP破坏相互作用的情况下可能产生重子不对称。我们还研究了来自霍金辐射的直接引力波（GW）信号以及来自PBH密度涨落的诱导GW，后者在出现早期PBH主导时期时产生。对于代表性基准参数，所得重子不对称可达到观测值的百分之十量级，而诱导GW信号在约$10$-$10^2\,{\rm Hz}$的频率处可达到峰值振幅$Ω_{\rm GW,0}h^2\sim10^{-7}$。
